rulesets.p: Hollow Knight environment PROP: a SINGLE object, 3/4 view, full silhouette readable. Near-monochrome — charcoal stone, bone-white rims, void-black hollows. Painterly ink-and-wash, thick dark outline. NOT pixel art, NOT isometric cottage, NOT bright thatch, NOT saturated green leaves. Cut off at its own base. NO ground, grass patch, or drop-shadow plate. Magenta #FF00FF background. No text.
